name: COMPTEL
summary: CGRO's MeV Compton telescope, whose diffuse gamma-ray observations provide important historical data for light-dark-matter annihilation or decay.
detection_principle: Measures energies, positions and time of flight for Compton scattering in an upper liquid-scintillator layer and absorption in a lower NaI layer to reconstruct incident-photon directions.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: The CGRO mission has ended; public data continue to support subsequent research.

collaboration.name: COMPTEL collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Institutional participation refers to the period covered by each source; this dossier does not claim to provide a complete membership list.

results.summary: Historical diffuse data have been reanalyzed to constrain light dark matter.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
